question: 2011 年 6 月的销售额怎么回事，环比降得厉害
answer: 2011 年 6 月 GMV 为 725,003 英镑，比 5 月的 739,914 英镑减少 14,911 英镑；净销售额为 711,289 英镑，比 5 月的 730,966 英镑减少 19,677 英镑。销售订单数从 1,668 单降到 1,523 单，活跃客户数从 1,054 个降到 990 个，说明主要是下单的客户和单数变少，而不是单价问题。主要拖累来自老客户的小额订单减少（小额老客户 GMV 减少约 70,700 英镑），其次是价值分层 B 档客户减少约 31,800 英镑，以及节日派对品类（主要是 PARTY BUNTING 商品）减少约 24,900 英镑。包袋收纳品类增长约 47,000 英镑，其中约 39,000 英镑来自客户 12700 的单张订单 556444，属于一次性大单，掩盖了下滑。若剔除这张大单，6 月 GMV 将比 5 月下降约 53,900 英镑。
sql:
SELECT substr(invoice_date,1,7) AS m,
SUM(CASE WHEN invoice_type='sale' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS gmv,
SUM(CASE WHEN invoice_type='return' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS ret,
SUM(CASE WHEN invoice_type='sale' THEN amount ELSE -amount END) AS net,
SUM(invoice_type='sale') AS orders,
COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN invoice_type='sale' THEN customer_id END) AS custs
FROM invoices WHERE invoice_date >= '2011-03-01' AND invoice_date < '2011-07-01' GROUP BY m ORDER BY m

SELECT substr(i.invoice_date,1,7) AS m, i.country, i.invoice_type,
SUM(i.amount) AS amt, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM invoices i WHERE i.invoice_date >= '2011-05-01' AND i.invoice_date < '2011-07-01'
GROUP BY m, i.country, i.invoice_type ORDER BY (m='2011-06') DESC, amt DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT substr(invoice_date,1,7) AS m, size_band, customer_type,
SUM(CASE WHEN invoice_type='sale' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS gmv, SUM(invoice_type='sale') AS orders
FROM invoices WHERE invoice_date >= '2011-05-01' AND invoice_date < '2011-07-01' AND invoice_type='sale'
GROUP BY m, size_band, customer_type ORDER BY size_band, customer_type, m

WITH s AS (SELECT substr(i.invoice_date,1,7) AS m, i.customer_id AS c, SUM(i.amount) AS amt
FROM invoices i WHERE i.invoice_type='sale' AND i.invoice_date >= '2011-05-01' AND i.invoice_date < '2011-07-01' AND i.customer_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m, c)
SELECT c, SUM(CASE WHEN m='2011-05' THEN amt ELSE 0 END) AS may_amt, SUM(CASE WHEN m='2011-06' THEN amt ELSE 0 END) AS jun_amt,
SUM(CASE WHEN m='2011-06' THEN amt ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN m='2011-05' THEN amt ELSE 0 END) AS diff
FROM s GROUP BY c ORDER BY diff ASC LIMIT 50

SELECT substr(i.invoice_date,1,7) AS m, COALESCE(c.value_tier,'guest') AS tier, SUM(i.amount) AS gmv, COUNT(*) AS orders, COUNT(DISTINCT i.customer_id) AS custs
FROM invoices i LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=i.customer_id
WHERE i.invoice_type='sale' AND i.invoice_date >= '2011-05-01' AND i.invoice_date < '2011-07-01' GROUP BY m, tier ORDER BY tier, m

SELECT substr(i.invoice_date,1,7) AS m, l.category, SUM(l.amount) AS gmv, SUM(l.quantity) AS qty
FROM invoice_lines l JOIN invoices i ON i.invoice_no=l.invoice_no
WHERE i.invoice_type='sale' AND i.invoice_date >= '2011-05-01' AND i.invoice_date < '2011-07-01' GROUP BY l.category, m ORDER BY l.category, m

SELECT l.category, l.stock_code, p.description,
SUM(CASE WHEN substr(i.invoice_date,1,7)='2011-05' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS may_amt,
SUM(CASE WHEN substr(i.invoice_date,1,7)='2011-06' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS jun_amt,
SUM(CASE WHEN substr(i.invoice_date,1,7)='2011-06' THEN l.amount ELSE -l.amount END) AS diff
FROM invoice_lines l JOIN invoices i ON i.invoice_no=l.invoice_no JOIN products p ON p.stock_code=l.stock_code
WHERE i.invoice_type='sale' AND i.invoice_date >= '2011-05-01' AND i.invoice_date < '2011-07-01'
AND l.category IN ('包袋收纳','节日派对','灯饰蜡烛')
GROUP BY l.category, l.stock_code ORDER BY ABS(diff) DESC LIMIT 15

SELECT l.stock_code, i.invoice_no, i.customer_id, i.country, i.invoice_date, l.quantity, l.unit_price, l.amount
FROM invoice_lines l JOIN invoices i ON i.invoice_no=l.invoice_no
WHERE i.invoice_type='sale' AND l.stock_code IN ('22502','47566') AND i.invoice_date >= '2011-05-01' AND i.invoice_date < '2011-07-01'
ORDER BY l.amount DESC LIMIT 20

question: 帮我分析一下 2010 年 7 月成交额降是什么导致的（对比 2010 年 6 月）
answer: 2010 年 7 月成交额为 50.07 万，比 6 月的 69.64 万下降 19.58 万（-28.11%），主要拖累来自“包袋收纳”品类：从 17.39 万骤降到 2.25 万，减少 15.13 万（-87%），约占总降幅的 77%。其他方面，英国市场减少 18.26 万（-30.4%），新客减少 7.14 万（-55.8%）；中小额单据（small、medium）合计减少约 18.65 万。只有“家居装饰”小幅增长 0.49 万。
sql: WITH b AS (SELECT substr(i.invoice_date,1,7) AS m, i.invoice_no, l.amount, l.category, i.customer_type, i.size_band, c.market FROM invoice_lines l JOIN invoices i ON i.invoice_no=l.invoice_no LEFT JOIN countries c ON c.country=i.country WHERE i.invoice_type='sale' AND substr(i.invoice_date,1,7) IN ('2010-06','2010-07')), d AS (SELECT '总计' AS dimension, '全部' AS val, m, amount, invoice_no FROM b UNION ALL SELECT '市场', market, m, amount, invoice_no FROM b UNION ALL SELECT '新老客', customer_type, m, amount, invoice_no FROM b UNION ALL SELECT '单据金额分档', size_band, m, amount, invoice_no FROM b UNION ALL SELECT '品类', category, m, amount, invoice_no FROM b) SELECT dimension, val, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN m='2010-06' THEN amount ELSE 0 END),2) AS jun_gmv, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN m='2010-07' THEN amount ELSE 0 END),2) AS jul_gmv, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN m='2010-07' THEN amount ELSE 0 END)-SUM(CASE WHEN m='2010-06' THEN amount ELSE 0 END),2) AS gmv_change, ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN m='2010-07' THEN amount ELSE 0 END)-SUM(CASE WHEN m='2010-06' THEN amount ELSE 0 END))*100.0/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN m='2010-06' THEN amount ELSE 0 END),0),2) AS mom_pct, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m='2010-06' THEN invoice_no END) AS jun_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m='2010-07' THEN invoice_no END) AS jul_orders FROM d GROUP BY dimension, val ORDER BY dimension, gmv_change

question: 帮我分析一下 2010 年 7 月成交额降是什么导致的（对比 2010 年 6 月）
answer:
2010 年 7 月 GMV 从 6 月的 £696,439.47 降到 £500,665.68，减少了 £195,773.79，相对下降 28.1%。

最主要的原因是品类"包袋收纳"：它的贡献项从基期的 £173,878.88 降到本期的 £22,549.08，变化 −£151,329.80，占总变化的 77.3%，而它按正常情况的预期份额只有 25.0%（正常波动范围为 24.5%），可见这一品类的下滑明显超出了整体水平。

去掉包袋收纳之后，总变化为 −£44,443.99，也就是说其余部分仍有小幅下降，但已经不是主要矛盾。

分析停在这一层，是因为剔除包袋收纳后，没有哪个分组的超额贡献达到 20%，其余分组基本是同比例变化，所以后续应优先查包袋收纳在 7 月为何大幅萎缩，例如缺货、下架、促销结束或大客户订单减少。

question: 帮我分析一下 2010 年 7 月成交额降是什么导致的（对比 2010 年 6 月）
answer: 2010年7月GMV为500,665.68英镑，较6月的696,439.47下降195,773.79英镑（约-28.1%）；订单数从1612降到1443，活跃客户从1034降到906。最主要原因是“包袋收纳”品类，下降151,329.80英镑，约占降幅的77%，而它在6月只占GMV约25%（173,878.88）。其次是英国本土市场，下降182,559.69英镑，约占降幅的93%，但英国本来就占6月GMV的86%，所以不算特殊。降幅分散在多个包袋单品上（如JUMBO BAG RED RETROSPOT -7,516）和多位客户上，没有单一商品或单张发票主导。6月客户11644的包袋大单（单行1,203.5）在7月没有再出现，也是原因之一（该客户包袋额-10,396）。按客户类型看，新客下降71,367（6月基数127,950），降幅比例最大。

question: 帮我分析一下 2010 年 7 月成交额降是什么导致的（对比 2010 年 6 月）
answer: 7月成交额较6月减少约19.58万元（从69.64万降至50.07万），其中**包袋收纳**下降15.13万元，占总降幅的约77%，是主要原因；其他品类合计减少约4.47万元，仅家居装饰小幅增长4860元。查询结果只到品类层面，无法判断包袋收纳下滑的具体原因（如订单量、客单价或是否有大额订单缺失），需要进一步按订单或客户拆分查看。
sql: SELECT il.category, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN substr(i.invoice_date,1,7)='2010-06' THEN il.amount ELSE 0 END),2) AS gmv_2010_06, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN substr(i.invoice_date,1,7)='2010-07' THEN il.amount ELSE 0 END),2) AS gmv_2010_07, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN substr(i.invoice_date,1,7)='2010-07' THEN il.amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN substr(i.invoice_date,1,7)='2010-06' THEN il.amount ELSE 0 END),2) AS change_amount FROM invoice_lines il JOIN invoices i ON il.invoice_no = i.invoice_no WHERE i.invoice_type = 'sale' AND substr(i.invoice_date,1,7) IN ('2010-06','2010-07') GROUP BY il.category ORDER BY change_amount

question: 帮我分析一下 2010 年 7 月成交额降是什么导致的（对比 2010 年 6 月）
answer: 2010 年 7 月 GMV 为 500,665.68 英镑，比 6 月的 696,439.47 英镑减少 195,773.79 英镑，降幅 28.1%。主要原因是「包袋收纳」品类几乎停止成交：该品类 GMV 从 6 月的 173,878.88 英镑降到 7 月的 22,549.08 英镑，减少 151,329.80 英镑，占总降幅的约 77%，而它在 6 月 GMV 中的占比只有约 25%。该品类的成交客户数也从 838 个降到 64 个，订单数从 1,202 单降到 89 单，且降幅集中在英国本土市场（英国本土 GMV 减少约 182.6 万中的主体部分，海外仅减少约 1.3 万英镑）。其中无编号订单、客户 11644 和客户 12255 三者合计约占包袋收纳降幅的四分之一，但这不是主因，主因是整体客户群的包袋购买断档。退货额从 26,336.86 降到 17,132.73 英镑，对净额有小幅缓冲，但不改变结论。

question: 2011 年 6 月销售额掉了，为什么？和 2011 年 5 月比
answer: 2011 年 6 月销售额为 693,277.75，比 5 月的 739,914.35 减少约 46,636.6（约 -6.3%）。主要原因是订单量和客户数下降：订单从 1,668 单降到 1,521 单（-8.8%），下单客户从 1,054 降到 988，销量也从 394,641 件降到 372,143 件；而客单价其实略升，从 443.59 涨到 455.80，所以不是单价问题。
sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', i.invoice_date) AS month, ROUND(SUM(l.amount),2) AS gmv, COUNT(DISTINCT i.invoice_no) AS orders, COUNT(DISTINCT i.customer_id) AS customers, ROUND(SUM(l.amount)*1.0/COUNT(DISTINCT i.invoice_no),2) AS avg_order_value, SUM(l.quantity) AS units FROM invoices i JOIN invoice_lines l ON l.invoice_no=i.invoice_no WHERE i.invoice_type='sale' AND strftime('%Y-%m', i.invoice_date) IN ('2011-05','2011-06') GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

answer: 2011年6月GMV从5月的£739,914.35降到£693,277.75，减少£46,636.60，相对变化为−6.3%。最主要的原因是品类“灯饰蜡烛”：它的贡献项从基期的£65,802.89降到本期的£28,641.40，变化−£37,161.49，占总变化的79.7%，而按它的体量，预期份额只有8.9%，明显超出正常水平。去掉灯饰蜡烛后，总变化只剩−£9,475.11，其余品类的下滑幅度小得多。继续下钻后，没有哪个分组的超额贡献达到20%，其余分组基本是同比例变化，所以分析停在品类这一层。需要留意的是，灯饰蜡烛的正常波动范围是48.6%，这个品类本身起伏较大，建议确认6月的下滑是否属于季节性或备货节奏变化。

question: 2011 年 6 月销售额掉了，为什么？和 2011 年 5 月比
answer: 2011年6月销售额（GMV）为693,278英镑，比5月的739,914英镑减少46,637英镑，约下降6.3%；订单数从1,668单降到1,521单。退货额同时从8,948英镑升到13,714英镑，所以净销售额降得更多。首要原因是小额订单（<1000英镑）减少78,244英镑（5月为469,846英镑），老客减少81,775英镑（5月为611,591英镑）。大额订单反而增加50,186英镑，其中包括6月客户12700的一张38,970英镑订单，但它没能弥补小额订单的缺口。第二个原因是英国本土减少29,810英镑，海外也在下降：澳大利亚减少13,638英镑（5月的11,925英镑大单没有再出现），德国减少11,476英镑。品类上，灯饰蜡烛减少37,161英镑（5月为65,803英镑），厨房餐饮减少14,297英镑，节日派对减少13,937英镑；包袋收纳增加36,751英镑，抵消了一部分。

question: 2011 年 6 月销售额掉了，为什么？和 2011 年 5 月比
answer: 6 月销售额环比 5 月减少 46,636.60 元（739,914.35 → 693,277.75）。主要拖累是**灯饰蜡烛**，减少 37,161.49 元，降幅约 56%，约占净降幅的 80%；其余 8 个品类合计下降，仅**包袋收纳**逆势增长 36,750.68 元，部分抵消了跌幅。结果只能说明各品类的变化幅度，无法说明灯饰蜡烛下滑的具体原因。

question: 2011 年 6 月销售额掉了，为什么？和 2011 年 5 月比
answer: 2011年6月净销售额为679,564英镑，比5月的730,966英镑减少51,402英镑，环比下降7.0%；按GMV口径，销售额从739,914降到693,278英镑，减少46,637英镑（下降6.3%）。退货额从8,948升到13,714英镑，增加4,766英镑，也拖累了净额。主要原因有三点：第一，4个大客户的采购在6月明显减少，合计减少41,079英镑，约占GMV降幅的88%；第二，灯饰蜡烛品类从65,286降到26,632英镑，减少38,653英镑，是净额下降的最大品类因素，其中白色挂式心形烛台（85123A）单品减少8,408英镑；第三，小额订单（<1000英镑）GMV减少78,244英镑（从469,846降到391,602），订单数从1,543降到1,410，大额订单增加约50,000英镑部分抵消了这一降幅。

SELECT substr(invoice_date,1,7) AS m,
 ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN invoice_type='sale' THEN amount ELSE 0 END),2) AS gmv,
 ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN invoice_type='return' THEN amount ELSE 0 END),2) AS returns,
 ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN invoice_type='sale' THEN amount ELSE -amount END),2) AS net,
 SUM(invoice_type='sale') AS orders,
 COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN invoice_type='sale' THEN customer_id END) AS customers
FROM invoices WHERE invoice_date >= '2011-04-01' AND invoice_date < '2011-07-01' GROUP BY m ORDER BY m

SELECT substr(i.invoice_date,1,7) AS m, c.market,
 ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN i.invoice_type='sale' THEN i.amount ELSE -i.amount END),2) AS net
FROM invoices i LEFT JOIN countries c ON c.country=i.country
WHERE i.invoice_date >= '2011-05-01' AND i.invoice_date < '2011-07-01' GROUP BY m, c.market ORDER BY c.market, m

SELECT substr(i.invoice_date,1,7) AS m, l.category,
 ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN i.invoice_type='sale' THEN l.amount ELSE -l.amount END),2) AS net
FROM invoice_lines l JOIN invoices i ON i.invoice_no=l.invoice_no
WHERE i.invoice_date >= '2011-05-01' AND i.invoice_date < '2011-07-01' GROUP BY m, l.category ORDER BY l.category, m

SELECT l.stock_code, MAX(p.description) AS name,
 ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN substr(i.invoice_date,1,7)='2011-05' AND i.invoice_type='sale' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END),2) AS may_gmv,
 ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN substr(i.invoice_date,1,7)='2011-06' AND i.invoice_type='sale' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END),2) AS jun_gmv
FROM invoice_lines l JOIN invoices i ON i.invoice_no=l.invoice_no LEFT JOIN products p ON p.stock_code=l.stock_code
WHERE l.category='灯饰蜡烛' AND i.invoice_date >= '2011-05-01' AND i.invoice_date < '2011-07-01'
GROUP BY l.stock_code ORDER BY (jun_gmv-may_gmv) ASC LIMIT 10

SELECT i.invoice_no, i.invoice_date, i.customer_id, i.country, i.amount, i.size_band
FROM invoices i WHERE i.invoice_type='sale' AND i.invoice_date >= '2011-05-01' AND i.invoice_date < '2011-07-01'
AND i.size_band='large' ORDER BY i.amount DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT i.size_band, substr(i.invoice_date,1,7) AS m, COUNT(*) AS n, ROUND(SUM(i.amount),2) AS gmv
FROM invoices i WHERE i.invoice_type='sale' AND i.invoice_date >= '2011-05-01' AND i.invoice_date < '2011-07-01'
GROUP BY i.size_band, m ORDER BY i.size_band, m

SELECT substr(invoice_date,1,7) AS m, customer_type, COUNT(*) AS orders, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN invoice_type='sale' THEN amount ELSE 0 END),2) AS gmv
FROM invoices WHERE invoice_type='sale' AND invoice_date >= '2011-05-01' AND invoice_date < '2011-07-01' GROUP BY m, customer_type ORDER BY customer_type, m

WITH g AS (SELECT customer_id, substr(invoice_date,1,7) AS m, SUM(amount) AS amt FROM invoices WHERE invoice_type='sale' AND customer_id IS NOT NULL AND invoice_date >= '2011-05-01' AND invoice_date < '2011-07-01' GROUP BY customer_id, m)
SELECT customer_id, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN m='2011-05' THEN amt ELSE 0 END),2) AS may_amt, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN m='2011-06' THEN amt ELSE 0 END),2) AS jun_amt,
ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN m='2011-06' THEN amt ELSE -amt END),2) AS delta FROM g GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY delta ASC LIMIT 10

WITH g AS (SELECT customer_id, substr(invoice_date,1,7) AS m, SUM(amount) AS amt FROM invoices WHERE invoice_type='sale' AND customer_id IS NOT NULL AND invoice_date >= '2011-05-01' AND invoice_date < '2011-07-01' GROUP BY customer_id, m),
d AS (SELECT customer_id, SUM(CASE WHEN m='2011-06' THEN amt ELSE -amt END) AS delta FROM g GROUP BY customer_id)
SELECT SUM(delta<0) AS n_down, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN delta<0 THEN delta ELSE 0 END),2) AS down_total, SUM(delta>0) AS n_up, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN delta>0 THEN delta ELSE 0 END),2) AS up_total,
SUM(delta<0 AND delta<=-5000) AS n_big_down, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN delta<=-5000 THEN delta ELSE 0 END),2) AS big_down_total FROM d
UNION ALL SELECT 'returns_by_return_month', NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL FROM (SELECT 1)
